title: Tap, Tap, the Hammers Sing
lyrics:
[Verse 1]
The building work grew slow and hard
When neighbors said, "Now stop!"
Two prophets cheered, "Keep going on!
God's with you to the top!"

[Chorus]
When something good is hard to do,
The Lord stays close to you.
He's right beside you, tap, tap, tap,
Until the work is through.

[Verse 2]
A new king found the promise made
And said, "Let them build high!"
So tap, tap, tap, the hammers sang,
The temple reached the sky.

[Chorus]

[Verse 3]
Now rest your hands, the day is done,
Sleep now, my little one.
For when it's hard, the Lord stays near
Till all your work is done.

[Chorus]
mood: Building music. A light, tapping pulse ticks under the voice like little hammers, cheerful and steady, the sound of work that keeps going even when it is hard. The chorus lifts as the temple rises higher. By the last verse the tapping slows and softens to a gentle rock, the hammers put away, and the song lands low and restful.
